data.camera: cowboy shot, dynamic idol pose under arena spotlights
data.description: 【星野爱 · B 小町演唱会】万人场馆的聚光灯下，星野爱跃上舞台最高点，粉裙与兔耳发饰在光柱中飞扬，星形瞳孔倒映着整片应援海——「把爱送给大家！今天也要好好应援哦！」
data.promptProse: Ai Hoshino springs onto the highest part of the arena stage in her pink frilled idol dress, heart brooch and rabbit hair ornament lifting with the movement. Her star-shaped eyes face the sea of audience lights beyond the cowboy-shot foreground. Arena spotlights catch the glove frills and skirt layers from above, while the fans' glowing light sticks form a distant colorful field beneath the darker seating tiers.
data.title: 星野爱 · B 小町演唱会
